findings.current: “And what were you thinking when you said you’d kill your Disciple, just to live up to your title as the Slaughter Saint for the first time in ages?”
findings.defect: The draft makes Jeok Cheongang the would-be killer. He had accused the Slaughter Saint of trying to kill Jeok’s Disciple.
findings.rationale: The Slaughter Saint is recounting Jeok Cheongang’s accusations against him; the following reply is Jeok’s concession that he went too far.
findings.replacement: “And what possessed you to accuse me of trying to live up to my title as the Slaughter Saint by killing your Disciple?”
findings.source: 간만에 살성이라는 별호값 하려고 제자 죽인다는 소리는 도대체 어떤 생각으로 내뱉은 거지?

findings.defect: The generic phrasing drops the Master–Disciple bond the Slaughter Saint explicitly names.
findings.rationale: 사제지간 specifies their relationship, which explains Jeok Cheongang’s relentless concern in the next sentence.
findings.replacement: “Quite the bond between Master and Disciple.
findings.source: 사제지간(師弟之間)의 정이 아주 두텁더군.

summary: One reversed accusation and one loss of the Master–Disciple relationship.
